skills.name: 靶定线程
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成衍射伤害。
施放普攻第1段后，长按普攻，将会持续攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。持续长按一定时间后将会施放重击第1段。
普攻第3段命中目标且在施放后一定时间内长按普攻将会施放重击第2段。

重击
消耗耐力，甩出分子线造成衍射伤害。
重击第1段命中目标且持续长按普攻，将会施放重击第2段，造成衍射伤害。
重击第1段施放后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第3段。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。

闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第4段。
该技能命中目标后一定时间内长按普攻将会施放重击第2段。

普攻·线程撕裂
处于算法压缩状态时，普攻替换为普攻·线程撕裂。
进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成衍射伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害。

重击·单线程
处于算法压缩状态时，重击替换为重击·单线程。
消耗耐力攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻且自身处于空中时，将会施放空中攻击·算法压缩。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻且自身处于地面时，将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。

重击·双线程
处于算法压缩状态时且【根权限】达到100点时重击·单线程替换为重击·双线程。
消耗耐力和所有【根权限】攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内长按或短按普攻且自身处于空中时，将会施放重击·多线程。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻且自身处于地面时，将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。

重击·多线程
消耗耐力攻击目标，造成衍射伤害并附加【骇破·偏移】。施放时若自身持有SQL，则使本次伤害倍率提升270%并移除SQL。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。

空中攻击·算法压缩
处于算法压缩状态时，空中攻击替换为空中攻击·算法压缩。
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。

闪避反击·算法压缩
处于算法压缩状态时，闪避反击替换为闪避反击·算法压缩。
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第3段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack right after Basic Attack Stage 1 to continuously attack the targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Hold this skill for a certain amount of time to cast Heavy Attack Stage 1.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to lash out against the enemies with Monowire, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack after Heavy Attack Stage 1 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack Stage 1 to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after this skill lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Thread Shredding
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding.
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Single Threading
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading.
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Dual Threading
When in Algorithm Compaction and Root Access reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Single Threading is replaced with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading.
Consume STA and all Root Access to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Multi-threading
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target. SQL can be consumed for a 270% increase in this attack's DMG Multiplier.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction
When in Algorithm Compaction, Mid-air Attack is replaced with Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction
When in Algorithm Compaction, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 3.

skills.name: 协议突破
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·有效载荷
施放共鸣技能·有效载荷向前方突进造成衍射伤害并附加【骇破·偏移】。命中目标时将自动施放追加攻击，造成衍射伤害，同时激活共鸣技能·脉冲干扰。若突进攻击没有命中目标，则减少70%的冷却时间。若突进攻击施放过程中被打断或未施放完成，则不会减少冷却时间。
施放追加攻击后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。
追加攻击命中目标后一段时间内长按普攻将会施放重击第2段。

共鸣技能·脉冲干扰
施放共鸣技能·脉冲干扰穿越目标造成衍射伤害并短暂停滞敌方目标。施放该技能后为露西附加非正式握手。
非正式握手：露西未处于算法压缩状态且为队伍中登场角色时，每秒持续获得【传输协议】，当【传输协议】达到100点、施放共鸣解放·网络行者或共鸣解放·暗网深潜后移除该效果。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。

共鸣技能·死锁
当【传输协议】达到100点或露西处于算法压缩状态下时，共鸣技能·有效载荷和共鸣技能·脉冲干扰替换为共鸣技能·死锁。
施放共鸣技能·死锁对目标造成衍射伤害同时附加【骇破·偏移】，此次伤害为重击伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。
施放共鸣解放·网络行者或共鸣解放·暗网深潜后，将重置共鸣技能·死锁的冷却时间。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Skill - Payload
Cast Resonance Skill - Payload to charge forward, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting. Upon hitting the target, a follow-up attack is automatically triggered, dealing Spectro DMG and activating Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference. If no target is hit during the charge, reduce the skill CD by 70%. If the charge is interrupted or not successfully cast, the skill CD is not reduced.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after the follow-up attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after follow-up attack lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference
Cast Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference to cut through the target, dealing Spectro DMG and briefly Stagnating the target, before granting Digital Handshake. 
Digital Handshake: When Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction and is the active Resonator in the team, she gains TCP every second. This effect is removed when TCP reaches 100 points or when Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is cast.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Deadlock
When TCP reaches 100 points or Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Cast Resonance Skill - Deadlock to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.
Reset the CD of Resonance Skill - Deadlock after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.

skills.name: 网络行者
skills.desc:
共鸣解放·网络行者
露西深潜赛博空间并展开协议界面，持续10秒。协议界面开启期间可选择共计7种不同的欺骗程式，每种欺骗程式消耗的Ram点数不同，初始露西拥有24点Ram点数。
处于协议界面时，露西会依次标记视野中一定范围内的目标，被标记的目标将会受到后续所有欺骗程式的效果。可通过调整露西的视角来标记更多目标。当视野中一定范围内无目标时，将无法施放任何欺骗程式。
处于协议界面时，当协议界面的持续时间结束或长按普攻，将对所有标记目标发起覆写篡改，造成衍射伤害并退出协议界面，此次伤害为重击伤害。当所有Ram点数消耗完毕或剩余Ram点数无法再施放任何欺骗程式时，点按普攻将对所有标记目标发起覆写篡改。
该技能可在低空施放。

欺骗程式·集群入侵
消耗2点Ram。拓展标记视角，施放效果后无需调整视野，直接标记露西周围一定范围内的所有目标，同时对周围的标记目标造成衍射伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
欺骗程式·义体故障
消耗4点Ram。使所有标记目标受到伤害提升5%，持续30秒。
欺骗程式·突破协议
消耗4点Ram。使所有标记目标降低5%的防御，持续30秒。
欺骗程式·突触熔融
消耗5点Ram。对一定范围内的所有标记目标造成衍射伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
欺骗程式·运动失能
消耗6点Ram。对所有标记目标造成骇破伤害并降低5%的攻击，持续30秒。
欺骗程式·武装故障
消耗5点Ram。使所有标记目标造成伤害时攻击有一定概率降低100%，持续30秒。
欺骗程式·赛博精神病
消耗6点Ram。干扰所有标记目标使其变为中立阵营，并削减共振度。转变阵营的效果只对轻波级敌人生效。

共鸣解放·暗网深潜
露西处于算法压缩状态且施放重击·多线程后，共鸣解放·网络行者替换为共鸣解放·暗网深潜。拥有共鸣解放·网络行者的所有效果，并使覆写篡改伤害倍率大幅提升。
施放共鸣解放·暗网深潜后或露西退出算法压缩状态，共鸣解放·暗网深潜替换为共鸣解放·网络行者。
该技能可在低空施放。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Liberation - Netrunner
Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for 10s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to 7 different Spoofing Program effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with 24 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all Spoofing Program effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no Spoofing Program can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when Normal Attack is held down, Override is triggered, which deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any Spoofing Programs, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack to trigger Override on all marked targets. 
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Spoofing Program: Ping
Requires 2 RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals Spectro DMG to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction

skills.name: 幽灵义体
skills.desc:
露西为队伍中登场角色且8秒内不受到任何伤害时，为自身添加1层光学欺骗效果，该效果初始上限为1层。
光学欺骗：受到攻击时使该次伤害降低100%，若该次攻击使自身处于受击或被击飞状态，将会立即自动脱离受击状态或被击飞状态，若此时处于地面则触发成功闪避效果，效果触发后移除1层光学欺骗。该效果0.5秒内只能触发1次。
skills.descEn:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for 8s, she gains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Optical Illusion. Max 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} by default.
Optical Illusion: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by 100%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful Dodge if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of Optical Illusion. This effect can be triggered up to 1 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=6} every 0.5s.

skills.name: 进程破解
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·有效载荷、共鸣技能·脉冲干扰或共鸣技能·死锁对怒涛级或海啸级敌人造成伤害时，露西为其附加傀儡标记，持续2分钟。傀儡标记持续时间内，队伍中的角色直接造成的伤害击败该目标时，露西获得【网络后门】效果，若丽贝卡在队伍中则也能获得同等效果。

【网络后门】
全伤害加深10%，骇破伤害倍率提升10%。效果持续2分钟，最多叠加2层。当叠加至2层时，额外获得全伤害加深5%，骇破伤害倍率提升5%。露西失去意识时，不会继续获得【网络后门】效果，同时已有的【网络后门】效果失效。
skills.descEn:
When Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, or Resonance Skill - Deadlock damages an Overlord Class or Calamity Class enemy, Lucy applies Botnet Mark on them for 2 min. While Botnet Mark is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the Network Backdoor effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.

Network Backdoor
Grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for 2 min and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by 5% and Hack DMG Multiplier by 5%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain Network Backdoor, and any existing Network Backdoor effects become invalid.

skills.name: 过时幻觉
skills.desc:
攻击目标，造成衍射伤害同时赋予队伍中角色非自愿共享效果，使其能看到障碍物后的目标，持续25秒。丽贝卡获得非自愿共享效果时效果增强，可以锁定障碍物后的目标。若场上存在丽贝卡的机枪塔则激活过载效果，使其造成的伤害提升，持续4秒。
施放该技能后，若露西未处于算法压缩状态，则一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。
施放该技能后，若露西处于算法压缩状态，则一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。
施放该技能后，下一次施放共鸣技能·脉冲干扰时额外获得20点【传输协议】。
skills.descEn:
Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and granting Resonators in the team Involuntary Sharing, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for 25s. Additionally, Involuntary Sharing is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for 4s.
If Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
If Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.
After casting this skill, the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 points of TCP.

skills.name: 黑墙深度
skills.desc:
云端接口
露西未处于算法压缩状态下时，攻击命中目标会获得【传输协议】。当【传输协议】达到100点时，共鸣技能·有效载荷和共鸣技能·脉冲干扰替换为共鸣技能·死锁。
施放共鸣解放·网络行者或共鸣解放·暗网深潜后会清空【传输协议】进度。

算法压缩
施放共鸣技能·死锁后露西进入算法压缩状态，并获得1层SQL。普攻替换为普攻·线程撕裂，重击替换为重击·单线程。自身衍射伤害加成提升65%，持续8秒。
算法压缩状态下，再次施放共鸣技能·死锁不会重复获得SQL和衍射伤害加成效果。
算法压缩状态下，普攻·线程撕裂、重击·单线程等攻击命中目标时可获得【根权限】。当【根权限】达到100点时，重击·单线程替换为重击·双线程。施放重击·双线程后短时间内点按普攻或长按普攻将会施放重击·多线程。
施放重击·多线程时若自身持有SQL，则使本次伤害倍率提升270%并移除SQL。
施放重击·多线程时若自身未持有SQL，则损失20%的当前生命值；当露西生命值低于1%时，不消耗生命值。
施放重击·多线程后共鸣解放·网络行者替换为共鸣解放·暗网深潜。
施放共鸣解放·网络行者、共鸣解放·暗网深潜后，或施放重击·多线程后8秒内不施放指定技能，将会退出算法压缩状态。指定技能包括：常态攻击·靶定线程、共鸣技能·协议突破、变奏技能·过时幻觉、谐度破坏·数据崩解。

骇破响应·数据崩解
露西对处于【骇破·干涉】状态的目标造成衍射伤害并附加数据崩解效果。此次伤害为骇破伤害。
数据崩解：当目标攻击造成伤害后触发，停滞目标0.5秒。效果触发后移除数据崩解。

【传输协议】获取规则
【传输协议】上限100点。
普攻、重击、空中攻击、闪避反击造成伤害时，获得【传输协议】。
共鸣技能·有效载荷、共鸣技能·脉冲干扰造成伤害时，获得【传输协议】。
施放变奏技能·过时幻觉后，下一次施放共鸣技能·脉冲干扰时额外获得20点【传输协议】。

【根权限】获取规则
【根权限】上限100点。
普攻·线程撕裂、重击·单线程、空中攻击·算法压缩、闪避反击·算法压缩造成伤害时，获得【根权限】。
skills.descEn:
Cloud Portal
When not in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains TCP upon hitting a target. At 100 points of TCP, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive clears all TCP.

Algorithm Compaction
After casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock, Lucy enters Algorithm Compaction and gains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of SQL. Her Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, and Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Lucy's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 65% for 8s.
While in Algorithm Compaction, casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock again will not grant SQL and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains Root Access upon hitting a target with attacks including Basic Attack - Thread Shredding and Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Reaching 100 points of Root Access replaces Heavy Attack - Single Threading with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack - Dual Threading to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy has SQL, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by 270% and remove SQL.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy does not have SQL, she loses 20% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below 1%, no HP is consumed.
After casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.
Lucy exits the the Algorithm Compaction state after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is not followed up by one of these skills: Normal Attack - Locked Thread, Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach, Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, and Tune Break - Data Crash.

Hack Response - Data Crash
Lucy deals Spectro DMG to a target inflicted with Hack - Interfered and applies the same target with Data Crash, considered Hack DMG.
Data Crash: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for 0.5s. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.

TCP
Lucy holds up to 100 points of TCP.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference.
After casting Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, casting the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A} of TCP.

Root Access
Lucy holds up to 100 points of Root Access.
Lucy gains Root Access when she deals damage through Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, Heavy Attack - Single Threading, Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction, and Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.

固有技能·幽灵义体中获取的光学欺骗层数上限提升至2层。
固有技能·幽灵义体获得强化：生命值低于50%时，自身受到攻击后获得1层光学欺骗，该效果有180秒的冷却时间。触发光学欺骗效果时，获得基于露西自身攻击力150%的护盾，持续10秒。
chains.descEn:
The stack limit of Optical Illusion obtainable via Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware is increased to 2.
Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware is now enhanced: When Lucy's HP falls below 50%, she immediately gains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Optical Illusion upon being hit. This effect has a Cooldown of 180s. When Optical Illusion is triggered, Lucy gains a Shield equal to 150% of ATK for 10s.

Targets with Hack - Shifting or in the Hack - Interfered state take 40% increased Heavy Attack DMG from Lucy.
